summary: The blueprint broadly covers human pancreas but needs targeted additions and splits for lymphatic endothelium, dendritic cells, mural subtypes, immune subtypes, and epsilon-cell marker specificity.

issues.where: vascular compartment / endothelial module and axes
issues.description: The blueprint has a generic blood endothelial axis but no lymphatic endothelial representation, an expected minor vascular population in human pancreas atlases.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a lymphatic endothelial module and axis using markers such as PROX1, LYVE1, PDPN, FLT4, CCL21, MMRN1, and/or TFF3, ideally contrasted or gated against the existing blood endothelial module.

issues.description: The mural module mixes pericyte markers with vascular smooth muscle markers, so the current axis cannot resolve two separable pancreas mural populations.
issues.suggested_fix: Split the current mural program into pericyte and smooth-muscle/contractile modules, and add an axis that distinguishes them while preserving a broad mural-vs-endothelial signal if desired.

issues.description: The leukocyte branch lacks dendritic-cell representation; macrophage-heavy C1Q/LST1 myeloid scoring does not adequately capture classical dendritic or antigen-presenting myeloid cells.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a dendritic-cell module and gated leukocyte axis using supported markers such as CD1C, FCER1A, CLEC10A, CLEC9A, LILRA4, IRF8, ITGAX, and HLA-DRA.

issues.where: t_nk_cell and b_plasma_cell modules / leukocyte gated axes
issues.description: The T/NK and B/plasma modules each merge biologically distinct leukocyte populations, causing the gated axes to blur cell identity.
issues.suggested_fix: Split T from NK/cytotoxic and B from plasma into separate modules and gated axes under leukocyte_common; retain broad immune axes only if they serve a separate coarse-grained purpose.

issues.description: The epsilon-cell module relies heavily on generic endocrine markers and includes MLN, which is more classically enteroendocrine/intestinal than a canonical pancreatic epsilon marker.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep epsilon only if the cited human pancreas resources support it for the age-unspecified scenario, but make the module more pancreas-specific around GHRL and supported co-markers; replace or drop questionable MLN if unsupported.

out_of_scope: I did not verify DOI/resource correctness; this report only judges biological coverage and marker plausibility.
